title: Synchrotron X-rays Uncover Crystalline Phase and Fine Structure of Zirconia
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Volume 105, Issue 12, Page 1574-1582, November 2026.
Yttria-stabilized zirconia (YSZ) has become indispensable in restorative dentistry; however, the influence of yttria content on its crystalline phases and fine structure remains incompletely understood. This study investigated how variations in yttria ...
